The '''Eocho Mountains''' were a range of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], hills, and deep valleys far south of the equator on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Within the western mountains, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established the city of [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]]. Several of the mountains in this range were filled with [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|caves]], which the Jedi mined for these precious [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]].<ref name="NoP" />
